mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 5.0% compresses equity valuations by increasing discount rates and reducing corporate borrowing capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of observations where FEDFUNDS > 5.0% over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.5 percentage point increase in unemployment rate over three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions and reduced consumer spending, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances where UNRATE increases by >0.5pp over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales exceeding 0.5% in the past month signal broad-based consumer demand weakness, reducing corporate revenue expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances where HOUST and RSAFS both decline >0.5% in the past month.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% year-over-year), elevated inflation levels signal impending monetary tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of observations where CPIAUCSL > 3.0% (year-over-year) over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: Strong non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) indicates robust economic activity and rising corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in <40% of observations where PAYEMS growth is above the 50th percentile (last 5 years).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 95.0 (index, 2017=100) over the past month signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output and profit expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of instances where INDPRO < 95.0 (index) over the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%) and high unemployment (UNRATE > 4.0%) signals stagflation, increasing economic uncertainty and reducing corporate profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5.0% and UNRATE > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts decline below 1500.0 (thousands of units) over the past month signals weakening consumer demand and reduced economic activity, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST falls below 1500.0 (thousands of units) in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of instances where HOUST < 1500.0 (thousands of units) over the last month.
